**The Role

**As Genmab continues its transformation into a fully integrated global biotech company, the Head of Total Rewards will architect a future-ready, technology-enabled global rewards strategy that aligns with our purpose, growth ambitions, and values.

This leader will combine expertise in executive compensation, global scalability, and digital enablement to create a next-generation total rewards model—anchored in data, automation, and human experience. The role will also build the structures, systems, and shared-service capabilities needed to scale efficiently while maintaining governance, equity, and agility.

The location is flexible across Genmab’s global hubs (Princeton, Copenhagen, Utrecht). We have a hybrid model that requires being onsite 60% of the time.

**Responsibilities

****Strategic Design & Operating Model

**

• Define and lead the evolution of Genmab’s total rewards philosophy and structure to support a global, end-to-end biotech organization.

• Design a modern total rewards operating model that integrates regional teams, shared services, and centers of excellence for consistent global delivery.

• Drive process standardization and automation to improve quality, transparency, and efficiency.

• Lead a strategic compensation team responsible for developing forward-looking frameworks, tools, and analytics that enable proactive support to HR Business Partners, Talent, and other COE stakeholders.

• Ensure the Total Rewards function continuously evolves its offerings to meet the changing needs of a high-growth, science-driven organization.

**Executive Compensation & Governance

**

• Serve as lead advisor to the Board’s Remuneration Committee on executive and equity compensation.

• Design performance-based and ESG-linked long-term incentive plans aligned with Genmab’s business strategy and culture.

• Ensure strong governance, compliance, and transparency in all executive pay matters.

• Bring external perspective and best-in-class practices to inform committee discussions and program evolution, ensuring Genmab remains competitive within the biotech and broader life sciences markets.

**Global Rewards Strategy & Wellbeing

**

• Oversee global compensation, benefits, recognition, and mobility programs that balance competitiveness, scalability, and inclusivity.

• Integrate skills-based pay, internal mobility, and evolving career architectures into the total rewards framework.

• Evolve wellbeing and flexibility offerings through technology and personalized employee experiences.

• Champion employee understanding and appreciation of Total Rewards by partnering with Communications and HR to create clear, engaging messaging that connects programs to our purpose, values, and “EVP”.

• Regularly assess market trends, benchmark data, and emerging innovations to identify opportunities for differentiation and continuous improvement.

**Technology, Automation & Data

**

• Lead implementation of digital total rewards platforms and process automation across compensation, benefits, and equity administration.

• Establish robust analytics capabilities for pay equity, retention risk, and predictive modeling.

• Drive continuous improvement through data insights, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

• Leverage advanced analytics to generate actionable insights for business leaders, enabling data-driven decisions around talent retention, productivity, and performance outcomes.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement

**

• Strengthen global governance structures and ensure alignment with regulatory, financial, and ethical standards.

• Create transparency and consistency through standardized processes, policies, and data.

• Build and mentor a global total rewards team with strong analytical and design skills.

**Requirements

**

• 15+ years of experience in total rewards, with significant leadership in global, complex organizations.

• Deep expertise in executive compensation design, governance, and disclosure.

• Proven success implementing technology, analytics, and automation within HR or total rewards functions.

• Experience designing shared-service or center of excellence models across geographies.

• Strong understanding of compensation and benefits regulations across multiple markets.

• Exceptional ability to influence and communicate at the executive and Board level.

• Demonstrated success leading and developing global teams, fostering capability growth and functional excellence.

• Proven ability to translate external best practices and market intelligence into actionable strategies tailored to the biotech industry.

**Attributes

**

• Visionary leader who designs systems for long-term scalability.

• Digital innovator who applies automation and analytics to improve the employee experience.

• Trusted advisor who balances strategic foresight with operational excellence.

• Inclusive, globally minded leader who champions fairness and sustainability in rewards.

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Biostatistics acts as a biostatistician supporting the clinical development of compounds as compound lead, primarily up until proof of concept, and/or as trial responsible statistician.

**Responsibilities

**Compound/Indication Level

• Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication

• Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies

• Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions

• Acts as a role model

• Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials

• Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor

• Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification

**CDT Member

**

• Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT

• Provide scientific advice to the CDT including design of trials, analyses and analyses requiring advanced statistical methodologies/techniques

• Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable

• Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders

• Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT

• Ensure availability of integrated database(s), as needed, and planning and conduct of integrated analysis to support development decisions, submissions, and marketing needs

• Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles

Trial Level

• Represent Genmab during meetings/congresses and courses and perform professional networking

• Engage with regulatory authorities on trial level discussions

• Arranges/attends lessons learned to share learnings

• Represents Genmab during Key Opinion Leaders meetings

• Ensure biostatistician review of partner synopsis, protocols, statistical analysis plans, results meetings presentations and clinical trial reports

• Coordinate data transfers from/to business partners in collaboration with the programmer and the data manager, as applicable

**CTT Member

**

• Participate and represent Biostatistics

• Review and provide input to protocol and amendment development

• Perform vendor oversight according to applicable SOPs

• Give input to eCRF setup, edit checks, validation plan, protocol deviations classifications, DSUR, IB updates, tables, figures, and listings etc.

• Review assay validation reports, as applicable

• Perform exploratory analysis, ad hoc analyses, and modelling of data

• Review and approve randomization and stratification plans

• Perform UAT of Randomization part of the IRT system as applicable

• Ensure procedures for blinding are in place as applicable

• Support timely delivery of statistical deliverables

• Responsible for planning and conducting trial result meetings

• Review and approve the CSR

• Attend operational and steering committee meetings, as applicable

• Support regulatory submission/filing activities

**Requirements

**

• MS / PhD or equivalent in a statistical discipline

• 5+ years of experience in relevant area preferred or demonstrated capability

• Experience in statistical analysis, modelling and simulation and adaptive trial designs

• Experience in working with clinical trials

• Preferred experience with oncology clinical trials

• Proficient programming skills in statistical software’s, such as SAS

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Ability to work independently as well as in teams

• Confident, self-reliant, and a quick learner

• Proactive and open-minded

• Ability to prioritize and work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Result and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

**Strengthen cybersecurity across our medical devices, cloud platforms and digital solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for a Cyber Security Engineer who will strengthen cybersecurity and information security across UNEEG Medical's products, cloud platforms and supporting infrastructure. You will help ensure that our solutions are developed, deployed and operated securely as we grow in the US healthcare market and continue to support customers across Europe.

You will be part of Technology (R&D) and act as UNEEG Medical's cybersecurity subject-matter expert. Working closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Clinical Operations and Commercial, you will embed security throughout the product lifecycle, manage cyber risks and support customer and regulatory security requirements.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity risks across products, cloud platforms and corporate systems

• Define and maintain cybersecurity controls, policies, standards and procedures

• Support secure-by-design practices, security reviews and threat modelling throughout product development

• Assist the software team in vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response, including root-cause investigations and remediations.

• Translate standards as ISO 27001, NIS2, IEC 81001-5-1, HIPAA, GDPR into a set of pragmatic standard operating procedures for UNEEG Medical to follow in order to be cyber security compliant.

• Maintain security documentation, risk assessments and evidence for audits and regulatory submissions

• Support cybersecurity requirements for medical devices and US healthcare market access

• Advise internal teams and support customer security questionnaires, risk assessments and cybersecurity discussions

• Promote cybersecurity awareness and collaborate with external security partners and auditors

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Combine solid technical expertise with a practical, hands-on and collaborative mindset

• See security as an enabler and help teams create secure solutions rather than acting as a gatekeeper

• Take ownership of risks and remediation activities and follow issues through to completion

• Are structured and document decisions, actions and evidence systematically

• Can communicate complex security topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy working across disciplines and continuously improving security practices

**Your background:

**

• A bachelor's or master's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, software engineering, IT infrastructure or a related field; equivalent practical experience may substitute formal education

• At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, information security, infrastructure security or cloud security

• Experience with FDA cybersecurity requirements for medical devices

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure security services and cloud security architecture

• Experience with vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response

• Knowledge of identity and access management, network security, endpoint security and secure system architecture

• Familiarity with cybersecurity risk management frameworks and standards

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• MedTech, healthcare IT, SaaS or other regulated environments

• ISO 27001, NIS2, IEC 81001-5-1, HIPAA, GDPR or similar frameworks

• DevSecOps and secure software development lifecycle practices

• Penetration testing management and security assessments

• Kubernetes, container security or cloud-native architecture

• Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, AZ-500, Security+, SC-100 or equivalent

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in supporting secure and scalable customer solutions in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG Medical, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

_Some games chase trends. Subway Surfers helped define an entire genre.

_Now, we're looking for a UI/UX Designer to help shape what comes next.

This is your chance to leave your mark on one of the biggest mobile games ever made. A game with a massive global audience, instant player feedback, and a team that never settles for "good enough". The challenge? Keeping an iconic game feeling fresh, modern, and innovative for hundreds of millions of players around the world.

Come help evolve the visual experience of Subway Surfers, designing new features, game modes, and player journeys while continuously improving the experience that keeps players coming back. Some days you'll be crafting entirely new interfaces. Other days you'll make a tiny change that unlocks a surprisingly big impact. That's the fun part.

If you enjoy solving creative puzzles, have a knack for details, and seeing your work reach millions of players, then this might just be your gig.

**Responsibilities

**

• Actively refine and improve existing UI/UX to elevate player engagement and satisfaction, ensuring Subway Surfers remains intuitive, modern, and enjoyable to play.

• Design and implement intuitive, engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing features.

• Create UX wireframes, user flows, and prototypes to support feature development and player experiences.

• Help shape the visual direction of the game's interface, evolving and modernizing the experience, while staying true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Ensure a consistent visual style, tone, and user experience across all UI elements.

• Create and maintain UI documentation, design systems, and style guides to support consistency and scalability.

• Optimize UI implementations to ensure smooth performance across a wide range of mobile devices.

Life at SYBO

**In your first month...

**You'll get to know the team, the game, and the players that have made Subway Surfers one of the most successful mobile games in the world. You'll be introduced to our tools, workflows, and ways of working while building relationships across the studio. With support from your teammates, you'll begin contributing to your first projects and quickly find your footing as part of the team.

**Within 3 months...

**You'll start taking ownership of more impactful work across the game, designing engaging interfaces and helping improve the player experience through thoughtful UI/UX solutions. You'll collaborate closely with the team to iterate on designs based on player feedback, insights, and performance data.

**By 12 months...

**You'll be a trusted contributor to the future of Subway Surfers, able to lead individual UI/UX initiatives across major features. At this point, your contributions to the UI style guide and visual framework will have enabled a smoother collaboration across teams, ensuring Subway Surfers will remain an evergreen.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI design work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging player experiences.

• Strong ability to create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and polished final designs that effectively balance player needs and business goals.

• Skilled at designing, rendering, and animating high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Advanced proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Knowledge of conducting user research and translating player insights into actionable design improvements.

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

Working hours

The position is for 16 hours per week. The working hours are:

Two weekdays per week: 3 hours after school, from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm

Thursdays: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm (4 hours)

Sundays: 11:00 am to 5:00 pm

What we offer

You will become part of a family-owned company with many dedicated employees. You will have a dedicated adviser who is available for guidance and support. Outside office hours, a staffed emergency phone line is always available, so you are never on your own.

Salary and pension are provided in accordance with the national collective agreement between FOA and the Danish Chamber of Commerce (Dansk Erhverv). You are covered by DUOS’ liability and occupational injury insurance, and health insurance is included as part of your pension scheme.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

Would you like to become our new colleague?

Please submit your application via the link. You must have a profile on mit.duos.dk and be logged in to apply. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. The position is available for an immediate start.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.

We understand the importance of combining empathy with the right professional expertise, and we know that finding the right match between an employee and the person receiving support is essential for our services to make a meaningful difference.

Join the DUOS team and make an important difference in another person’s life.

Learn more about DUOS at www.duos.dk.

jobs.occupation: Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics
jobs.description:
Aalborg University is seeking an outstanding Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics to lead the newly established Research Center for Energy Mathematics, a strategic collaboration with Centrica Energy.

As the Centrica Energy Chair, you will work at the interface of academic research and challenges in energy markets, quantitative analytics, data science, and algorithmic decision-making.

Your work tasks

This is primarily a research and research-leadership position. You will conduct international leading research in energy mathematics, develop a long-term research agenda, publish in top-journals, attract external funding, and strengthen Aalborg University's position in the field.

As Director of the Research Center for Energy Mathematics, you will build and lead a research community of PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, visiting scholars and international collaborators. Collaboration with Centrica Energy will provide opportunities to engage in real-world challenges while preserving academic freedom and the highest scientific standards. You will supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and master’s students. Teaching and administrative responsibilities are expected to be limited and organized to support the position’s focus on research and research leadership.

The aim is to establish a globally recognized center that advances fundamental and applied research in energy mathematics and contributes to academia, society, and the green energy transition

**Who we are looking for

**

We seek a researcher with a strong academic track record and the ambition to shape the emerging field of energy mathematics. Relevant expertise may include stochastic optimization, stochastic analysis, uncertainty quantification, mathematical modelling, machine learning, causal inference, computational mathematics, or related disciplines.

We welcome candidates with mathematical depth and broad intellectual curiosity, especially researchers who address fundamental questions about complex and uncertain energy systems and markets across traditional disciplinary boundaries. Applicants must demonstrate research experience at the highest international level through an outstanding publication record, doctoral supervision, competitive research funding and international collaboration.

In addition to scientific excellence, we are looking for a colleague who is enthusiastic about building and leading a collaborative research environment and with an openness to dialogue with industry.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must be able to document a high degree of original academic production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels. Including tests/exams, course/study programme management as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material.

Emphasis is placed on the extent, to which the applicant, has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

Emphasis may moreover be placed on the applicant’s ability to carry out and develop research-based public-sector consultancy. Also, emphasis will be placed on an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks and possibly fulfil other functions, for example in relation to the university’s external cooperation.

Emphasis will also be placed on the applicant's ability to undertake pedagogical supervision, supervision and academic assessment work.

Additional q ualification requirements

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in mathematics or in a closely related discipline and have a sustained record of original and influential research.

Emphasis will be placed on the ability to formulate and pursue ambitious research agendas and to establish and lead an internationally recognized research environment. Experience with competitive research funding, international collaboration, and mentoring doctoral and postdoctoral researchers is important.

Applicants must preferably document university teaching and supervision experience at the undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral level.

Leadership experience with research teams, centers, or large collaborative projects is a strong plus. The ability to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and engage with partners in academia, industry, and the public sector is also valued.

The assessment will consider scientific achievements, academic leadership, educational contributions, supervision experience, international standing, and the potential to strengthen Aalborg University's research and education in energy mathematics.

Who we are

The position is anchored at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Aalborg University, one of Scandinavia's leading environments for applied mathematics, stochastic modelling, and data-driven research. The department offers an international and collaborative research environment with strong links to academia, industry, and society.

The Research Center for Energy Mathematics is established through a strategic collaboration between Aalborg University and Centrica Energy, a leading European energy trading and energy management company active in power, gas, renewable energy, algorithmic trading, analytics, and quantitative research. While the professorship is an independent academic position at Aalborg University, the collaboration with Centrica Energy provides exceptional opportunities for research inspiration, access to relevant data and problems, and interaction with leading practitioners in quantitative energy trading and analytics.

Together, Aalborg University and Centrica Energy aim to create a globally recognized center in energy mathematics that attracts outstanding researchers and students from around the world.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Professor”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Postdoctoral Fellowship in Experimental Quantum Matter Quantum Matter Lab, Niels Bohr Institute Faculty of SCIENCE University of Copenhagen The Quantum Matter Lab at the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen, invites applicants for a postdoctoral fellowship to investigate topologically protected synthetic matter in 1D and 2D arrays of semiconductor-superconductor Josephson junctions formed in a variety of lattices. The project aims to explore novel states and dynamics of emergent quantum states, including topological matter and flat bands. The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The project 

  The work is at the border of quantum simulation and quantum matter and takes advantage of novel epitaxial hybrid materials. Candidates should have a PhD in condensed matter experimental physics, mesoscopic electron transport, or experimental solid-state quantum information science. The project combines nanofabrication, low-temperature measurements using a cryofree dilution refrigerator, low-noise and high frequency electrical measurement techniques, data analysis, and close collaboration with theoretical physicists. Scientific writing and communication will be in English.

  Inquiries about the position can be made to Associate Professor Saulius Vaitiekėnas (saulius@nbi.ku.dk).

  Description of the scientific environment

  The Quantum Matter Lab at the Niels Bohr Institute is a research group focused on experimental solid-state physics, quantum nanoelectronics, and condensed matter device physics. The group provides a vibrant scientific environment for cutting-edge experimental research, with close interactions with theorists and potential collaborations with industry.

  Our group is part of Condensed Matter Physics at the Niels Bohr Institute, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. We are based in Copenhagen and offer creative, stimulating working conditions within a dynamic, international research environment.

  The University and the group wish our staff to reflect on the diversity of society and thus welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

  Terms of employment 

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week. The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 2 years, with a possibility of extending the contract further.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY for position below.

jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

• Strong end-to-end project management skills and the ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Management, and external partners.

• Experience managing vendors, suppliers, and budgets, including negotiations with agencies and production partners.

• Confidence reporting on event performance, handling leads and coordinates their handover.

• Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage when working with headquarters and the local reference site network.

Experience developing a webinar strategy that generates sales opportunities is a plus. Alternatively, you are comfortable learning this skill quickly, as you will work closely with your future colleagues in Marcom on this.

Regular travel should be expected, and in busy periods, this can be 50% or more.

A thoughtful host with a hands-on mindset

You make people feel genuinely welcome and adapt naturally to different visitors and situations. You stay calm when plans change, take pride in the details and are just as comfortable shaping an experience concept as managing the on-site logistics. Open and approachable, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and senior stakeholders, communicate clear briefs, and know who needs which information — and when.

You bring creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach. You are curious about what works, use data and feedback to improve the programme and look for ways to make each visit or event meaningful rather than routine.

Axlab’s Marcom team works to build recognition of the Axlab brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories in its direct markets. Through consistent brand storytelling, impactful events, customer experiences and digital channels, the team connects colleagues and customers with that ambition. In this role, you will have ownership of the experiences that show what it means in practice.

What we offer

We are a small yet ambitious growth company where our shared values — Decency, Innovation, Commitment, and Responsibility — form the foundation of everything we do. We offer a flexible, hybrid, and trust-based full-time position where you will have influence on both your own role and the continued development of our Marcom function. Occasional travel activity must be expected as part of the role.

• A highly visible role with direct access to senior leadership

• Influence on business decisions and strategic initiatives

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• An international and collaborative working environment

• Welcoming and comfortable office space with everyday perks including free refreshments and daily lunch buffet

• Social activities and annual global events

About Churney

At Churney, we’re building the signal layer between company data and AI and advertising systems, enabling business-outcome-optimized AI at scale. We help advertisers make smarter, long-term decisions. We've built a system that maximizes Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) by sending predicted lifetime value (pLTV) conversion events to platforms like Google and Meta. The result: better bidding, higher returns and measurable impact.

We’re a small team growing fast, in a research-driven environment with ambitious, highly capable and collaborative teammates. Our ambition is to build the best experimentation culture in the world, and we value shared learning above all else. The impact of your work is directly measurable so you'll have a uniquely fast feedback loop on the outcomes you’re driving.

You’ll be expected to bring high energy, a growth mindset and a deep care for clients.

• You'll be trusted early. You won't spend weeks shadowing. You'll own real client relationships quickly, and what matters is whether those clients grow with Churney.

• We expect you to be hungry to learn the ins and outs of our tech stack, the ad platforms, and how pLTV can improve advertisers across different industries.

The role

You’ll be the technical bridge between Churney and our clients: integrating their data, shaping modeling decisions, running our ML pipelines to turn raw user data into value signals, validating real-world impact in the ad platforms, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience, and guiding clients to adopt our services at scale.

It's a genuinely hybrid role spanning data engineering, ML, ad-platform measurement, and client communication, which means broad exposure to the whole business and the chance to become a domain expert in an industry that turns over hundreds of billions of dollars a year, while working alongside some of the best engineers around.

We are looking for smart, motivated problem solvers who learn fast and want their work to have measurable impact. We welcome both junior and experienced candidates.

What you'll do

• Integrate client data: connect cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) and map messy, real-world data into our common data model.

• Configure and run our pLTV pipelines: set up and experiment within our production modeling pipeline to produce pLTV value signals.

• Own measurement and experimentation: design and run experiments (geo, A/B, lift, pre/post), diagnose signal loss and match quality in the Meta and Google interfaces (EMQ, signal ratio), and size the opportunity before launch.

• Validate impact and iterate: analyze results, confirm the signal is driving real ROAS, and tighten the loop.

• Communicate with clients: build a collaborative partnership with the client, present opportunity sizing and results to client stakeholders, proactively resolve issues, and drive adoption at scale.

• Improve the platform: collaborate with client leads and internal teams to automate toil and raise the quality of our tools and processes.

What we're looking for

• Strong Python and SQL: comfortable in large, messy datasets.

• Solid ML foundations: you understand modeling trade-offs even if you're not training models from scratch here.

• Excellent communication: you can explain a technical result to a non-technical client and hold the relationship.

• A measurement mindset (or strong appetite for one): curiosity about how ad attribution, identifiers, and incrementality actually work.

• Ownership and comfort with ambiguity: you can run multiple client projects at once in a space where the playbook is still being written.

• An automation and improvement instinct: you'd rather fix the workflow than repeat the toil.

Nice to have

• Experience with ad platforms and performance marketing (Google, Meta, TikTok).

• Direct, hands-on client experience.

• Modern cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).

• Background in A/B testing, causal inference, or LTV modeling.

• Experience building internal tooling or agentic AI workflows to speed up the above.

If you learn quickly, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to apply your data science skills to real, measurable client impact, we'd love to talk.

Apply for this role
